name: sdlc-work-claim
description: Stage 0 of the SDLC agentic pipeline: claims a Linear work unit across machines before any pipeline work starts. Uses Linear as the single cross-machine source of truth — sets the issue In Progress and writes a claim marker carrying session, host, branch, worktree, started, and heartbeat. Actions: check (BLOCK if held by a different live session, heartbeat < 30 min), claim (atomic compare-and-set, BLOCK on live conflict, reclaim a stale/dead session), heartbeat (refresh on stage transition), release (free on Done/abandon). Prevents two agents on two machines from both building the same ticket (observed 2026-06-09: two sessions both shipped XOS-25).
cadence: per-pipeline-run (claim at Stage 0; heartbeat at each stage transition; check again at Gate B)
litmus: Before pipeline work starts on a ticket: did Stage 0 CLAIM succeed (Linear issue set In Progress + claim marker written by this session)? Is the claim still held by this session (fresh heartbeat, not reclaimed) at Gate B before merge/push? If a different live session holds it — BLOCK. If unset LINEAR_API_KEY — FAIL-HARD (cross-machine coordination cannot work without it).
origin: 2026-06-09 — two sessions (this + a thewhycyborg session) both shipped XOS-25; one shipped a CI-red build the other had already fixed. SDLC agentic flows will run on multiple machines against the same Linear board; a local ledger cannot coordinate across machines, so the board itself is the claim substrate.
